text.approach: From Newhalem, drive or walk SR 20 east about 12 miles (0.4 mi west of Horsetail Creek, ~2.8 mi northeast of Colonial Creek Campground) to a turnout at about 1,900 ft elevation, directly across from a large boulder field on Ruby's northwest side.

text.overview: A steep, direct hike/scramble straight up Ruby's northwest ridge from a Highway 20 turnout — the most popular way up during winter and spring, when SR 20 is gated for the season.
text.descent: Retrace the ascent ridge, using snow ramps to negotiate cliff bands in winter/spring conditions; remove snowshoes for one cliffy section around 4,000 ft as needed on the way down as well.
